name: The Library of Echoing Constellations
description: A mystical library where the shelves are towering pillars of cosmic dust and the books are glowing constellations, creating an atmosphere of infinite knowledge and celestial wonder.
prompt: A vast, mystical library with towering shelves made of cosmic dust and nebulae, books glowing with soft starlight, constellations forming words on the pages, ethereal blue and purple ambient light, highly detailed, magical atmosphere, cosmic dust particles floating in the air, fantasy art, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting.
caption: Step into a world where knowledge is written in the stars. ✨📚 Which constellation would you read first?
